name: claude-ranger
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-body isolated Power Rangers-inspired AI agent Ranger sprite concept, genuinely transparent PNG. Reference 1 establishes the approved sturdy Ranger proportions, roughly four-and-a-half heads high, armor detailing, helmet construction, gloves, boots, broad shoulders and readable pixel-art treatment. Reference 2 is ONLY for the side-on slightly three-quarter ARCADE camera: horizontal footline, eye-level camera, minimal visible top surfaces. Discard its forest and enemies. Reproject the first character to this flatter camera. Face RIGHT with chest partially visible, neutral combat-ready stance, both knees slightly flexed. Shared costume: domed helmet, black wraparound visor, silver mouth plate, chunky shoulder shells, white/cream gauntlets and tall boots, dark undersuit joints, simple silver belt, compact utility blade held lowered with complete clearance. One dominant large chest insignia, no extra logos. Crisp deliberate 32-bit-console-era pixel clusters, consistent coarse logical pixel density, dark single outline, 3–4 hard shading levels per material, upper-left daylight. No smooth gradients, blur, antialiasing, painterly texture, text, labels, scenery, ground shadow, sparks or effects. Complete character and blade entirely inside square canvas with generous 10% transparent margins. Target character height approximately 80% of canvas; native-style silhouette around 96 logical pixels tall.
Claude identity: warm terracotta #D97757 armor with copper shadows, cream #F3E9D5 trim and charcoal black visor. Reference 3 is official installed Claude icon: integrate its irregular orange radial starburst with uneven rays as ONE large chest emblem on cream armor. A subtle fanned ridge above visor echoes it; no sun face, no letters.

name: villain-monster
prompt:
Generate ONE original generic tokusatsu Power Rangers villain concept, isolated on genuine transparent background. Reference 1 is a Ranger of the same game: MATCH its coarse crisp 32-bit-era pixel-art density, strong dark outlines, chunky hard 3–4-tone material shading, upper-left light, and sturdy proportions. Reference 2 provides ONLY the low side-on slightly three-quarter arcade camera on a horizontal lane. Do not copy its skull knight or forest. Villain faces LEFT toward Rangers, chest partly visible, full body neutral battle-ready stance. Original theatrical practical creature-suit/science-fiction costume, playful mildly menacing Saturday-morning tokusatsu. Clear segmented costume construction, readable at small browser workspace scale. No medieval armor, skeleton, skull face, mace, shield, gore, AI logos, text, background, ground shadow, glow or effects. Keep all limbs and appendages fully inside square canvas with generous clear 10% margin. Intentional pixel clusters not smooth gradients.
Monster of the week: 'Volt Mantis', a theatrical lime/olive insect creature costume, approximately 1.15 Ranger height. Broad sculpted angular mantis head with two short antennae, large orange faceted eyes, expressive rubber mouth, segmented chartreuse chest and abdomen, magenta shoulder fins, two oversized curved silver forearm pincers, chunky grasshopper boots. Bipedal person-in-costume anatomy, two arms and two legs; exaggerated campy readable silhouette, not realistic insect horror.

name: city-background
prompt: Generate a clean wide landscape 32-bit-era PIXEL ART modern city encounter background for Power Agents. Reference 1 is ONLY camera: horizontal side-on arcade beat-em-up viewpoint with slight three-quarter depth. Replace all forest, ruins, fantasy architecture and actors. Reference 2 establishes pixel cluster treatment and upper-left daylight. NO ACTORS, no people, no monsters, no text, no interface. Modern metropolitan plaza/broad street with simple horizontal pavement strips in lower third, restrained small street furniture at far edges, concrete sidewalk, understated shopfronts in middle distance, glass office towers and distant skyline under clear pale blue sky.
